assessments.name: NATO and NSPA supply
assessments.summary: Supplying NATO bodies and the NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA), and being assigned NATO stock numbers.

rules.title: NCAGE code
rules.reason: You need an NCAGE code to supply through NSPA or to have NATO stock numbers assigned. It is free of charge.

source.text: [DefenceGate technical appendix, NCAGE] a five-character entity identifier, required for NSN assignment, for registration in NATO and national supply systems, and for procurement through NSPA.

rules.title: AQAP quality certification
rules.reason: AQAP 2110 (or 2310 for aviation and space) is required where a NATO or national contract names it. This service cannot know which of your target contracts do.
rules.note: For Spain this is stated in a primary source: the Ministry of Defence says the PECAL, based on the AQAP, specify the quality requirements that suppliers must meet in the defence contracts that include them (read on 20 October 2026; rule ES-PECAL-CONTRACT of the Spanish defence supplier route, verified). For other countries it rests on the research notes.

source.text: [DefenceGate technical appendix, AQAP editions and who requires it] AQAP enters through individual contracts: when a prime or a national buyer names it, and it then cascades down the supply chain to subcontractors.

rules.title: AQAP editions as the Spanish Ministry of Defence lists them
rules.reason: When a contract names an AQAP or a PECAL, check the edition. The Ministry of Defence lists: PECAL 2110 Ed. 4 = AQAP-2110 Ed. D V1; PECAL 2310 Ed. B V1 = AQAP-2310 Ed. B V1; PECAL 2131 Ed. 3 = AQAP-2131 Ed. C V1 (final inspection and test, relevant to build-to-print component makers). PECAL 2210 is a supplement to 2110 or 2310. The contractual AQAP/PECAL 2000 series is a civil standard such as ISO 9001 plus NATO-specific requirements.

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (list of PECAL and AQAP editions)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad] Los requisitos de la serie de normas AQAP/PECAL 2000 contractuales son los requisitos de una norma civil (como por ejemplo, los de la ISO 9001) más una serie de requisitos específicos OTAN.

assessments.name: Spanish defence supplier (MoD)
assessments.summary: Supplying the Spanish Ministry of Defence, directly or as a subcontractor in its contracts: the defence industry register, PECAL quality, security clearances, catalogation, homologation, the Spanish defence-material licence and foreign ownership. For companies established in Spain.

rules.title: Registration in the defence industry register (RID)
rules.reason: You need a current RID certificate to be in the Ministry of Defence's catalogue of actual or potential suppliers, and for PECAL certification and the NATO Declaration of Eligibility. It is requested online from the DIGEID, with the company's electronic certificate.
rules.note: UNVERIFIED: the legal basis of the register, its fee, processing time and validity were not found in a primary source, so none is shown.

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, e-office procedure “Registro de la Industria de Defensa - RID” (SIA 993054)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, e-office procedure list, RID (SIA 993054)] TRAMITACIÓN DEL CERTIFICADO DE INSCRIPCIÓN O RENOVACIÓN DEL CERTIFICADO EN EL REGISTRO DE LA INDUSTRIA DE DEFENSA (RID) DE LA DIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE ESTRATEGIA E INNOVACIÓN DE LA INDUSTRIA DE DEFENSA (DIGEID), REQUISITO NECESARIO PARA FORMAR PARTE DEL CATÁLOGO DE PROVEEDORES REALES O POTENCIALES DEL MINISTERIO DE DEFENSA, ASÍ COMO OTROS PROCEDIMIENTOS DEL MINISTERIO DE DEFENSA.

rules.title: PECAL quality requirements come with the contract
rules.reason: The PECAL (Spanish quality publications based on NATO's AQAP) are requirements only of the defence contracts that include them. When a contract names one, you must meet it under the oversight of a DGAM quality representative (RAC). Read the technical (PPT) and administrative (PCAP) specifications of the contracts you target.
rules.consultant: Prime qualification: if you supply through a prime contractor and not the Ministry directly, the prime qualifies its suppliers by its own procedure, which none of the sources read here publishes. Ask the prime, or a consultant, what it requires.

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (PECAL)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad] Las publicaciones españolas de calidad (PECAL), que están basadas en las correspondientes publicaciones AQAP de la OTAN, especifican los requisitos de la OTAN y del Ministerio de Defensa de España para la gestión de la calidad que deben cumplir los suministradores en los contratos de Defensa en los que se las incluye

rules.title: Quality clauses and the DGAM-endorsed certificate of conformity
rules.reason: Ministry of Defence contracting bodies must put quality clauses in the technical (PPT) and administrative (PCAP) specifications, and a contract can be accepted only after the DGAM has endorsed the certificate of conformity of quality issued for it (Instrucción 39/1998, which implements O.M. 65/1993).

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad (Instrucción 39/1998)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, Aseguramiento de la calidad] [...] la inclusión de cláusulas de calidad en los Pliegos de Prescripciones Técnicas (PPT) y en los Pliegos de Cláusulas Administrativas Particulares (PCAP) y la obligatoriedad, para la recepción de un contrato, de que la DGAM haya refrendado previamente el correspondiente certificado de conformidad de calidad emitido para el mismo.

rules.title: PECAL certification of your quality management system (DGAM)
rules.reason: Answer the questions below to see whether you can apply for the PECAL certificate now.
rules.note: Initial audit by the DGAM; renewal and surveillance audits by certification bodies recognised by the CMDIN. The DGAM issues a quote for the fee. UNVERIFIED: no fee amount, processing time or validity period is published.

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación (SECAT-OC, Oficina Nacional de Catalogación)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación] La solicitud de un nuevo código NCAGE debe estar justificada por la necesidad de catalogar un producto adquirido por el MINISDEF o por ser necesario éste código para el registro en el “System for Award Management” (SAM) del gobierno de los EEUU. Esta solicitud ha de ser tramitada bien a través del Órgano de Catalogación del Ejército si se dispone de acceso logado a SICAD, o bien a través de la aplicación “ NCAGE Code Request Tool” (NCRT) si se carece de este acceso.

rules.title: Catalogation clause in Armed Forces supply contracts
rules.reason: Every Armed Forces contract for materials and spare parts must contain the catalogation clause (Reglamento de Catalogación, RD 166/2010, art. 21), so as a supplier you will be asked for the identification data of what you deliver.
rules.note: RD 166/2010 itself was not opened: its article 21 is quoted through the Ministry's page.

source.ref: Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación (RD 166/2010, art. 21, as the page quotes it)
source.text: [Ministerio de Defensa, Catalogación] De conformidad con lo indicado en el Artículo 21 del Reglamento de Catalogación de material de la defensa, en todos los contratos de adquisición de materiales y repuestos que se celebren en el seno de las Fuerzas Armadas es obligatorio incluir la cláusula contractual de catalogación en la que se regula el proceso de la catalogación de los materiales adquiridos.

rules.title: Defence homologation of the product (RD 165/2010)
rules.reason: Defence homologation is restricted to products for specific defence use (Article 346 TFEU), and it is mandatory only for those on the Ministry's list; for the others it is voluntary. On your answers, your product is not one for which it is mandatory.

source.text:
[Ministerio de Defensa, Homologación] La homologación de la Defensa se restringe a aquellos productos que sean de utilización específica en el ámbito de la defensa, de acuerdo con lo especificado en el artículo 346 del Tratado de Funcionamiento de la Unión Europea.

[Ministerio de Defensa, Homologación] Con carácter general la homologación se concederá por períodos de dos años.

rules.title: Which export regime applies to your product
rules.reason: You do not yet know whether your product is in the dual-use regime or the military regime. Find that out first: they are separate legal regimes with different licences, and a product can be in the military regime and not the dual-use one.

source.text: [DefenceGate technical appendix, Export control] Dual-use falls under 2021/821. Military goods fall under the Common Military List, with intra-EU transfers governed by Directive 2009/43/EC and separate licences. A product may sit in the military regime and not the dual-use one.

steps.name: NCAGE code
steps.summary: A five-character entity identifier from the NATO codification system. Needed for NATO and NSPA supply and for stock numbers. Free of charge.

days.text: Up to 14 working days on average; routine priority is 10 calendar days, emergency is 3 working days
days.note: Working days are converted to calendar days at 7/5 and rounded up: 3 working days is 5 calendar days and 14 working days is 20.

issuers.name: Unidad de Catalogación (SECAT-OC), acting as Oficina Nacional de Catalogación (ONC) for NATO, within SDG INREID, Dirección General de Armamento y Material (DGAM), Ministerio de Defensa
issuers.notes: A new NCAGE request has to be justified by the need to catalogue a product bought by the Ministry of Defence, or by registration in the US System for Award Management (SAM). It is made through the catalogation body of the Army branch if the company has logged access to SICAD, otherwise through the NSPA NCAGE Code Request Tool (Ministry of Defence catalogation page, read on 20 October 2026). No fee is published, in line with NATO policy; the word 'gratuito' does not appear on the Spanish ministry page.

steps.summary: NATO quality assurance requirements for design, development and production. Not an eligibility condition of EDF, EDIP or SAFE: it enters through individual contracts and cascades down the supply chain.

issuers.name: Spanish state route: PECAL, audited through DGAM structures
issuers.notes: The Spanish equivalent of AQAP is PECAL, audited through the structures of the Dirección General de Armamento y Material rather than a commercial certification body. On this route ISO 9001 from an ENAC-accredited body is a formal precondition, not only a practical one (DGAM procedure PA 4302); see the PECAL certification page.

steps.priceNote: In your country the state issues this itself, so the vendor price ranges in our sources do not apply and none is shown.

steps.name: PECAL certification (Spain, DGAM)
steps.summary: The Spanish state certification of a quality management system against PECAL 2110 or 2310 (the Spanish editions of AQAP). It needs the RID and ISO 9001 or EN 9100 first, and the initial audit expects prior PECAL contract experience.

neededFor.title: PECAL quality requirements come with the contract

steps.note: The chicken-and-egg of PECAL: the DGAM's initial audit expects a PECAL system audited by your management for at least nine months and at least one Ministry of Defence contract with PECAL requirements in the last two years (or a certificate of conformity signed by a DGAM quality representative). A newcomer therefore usually meets PECAL inside a first contract, under the quality representative's oversight, and applies for the certificate afterwards. It is not a block before a first contract: get the RID and ISO 9001 (or EN 9100) first.

issuers.name: Dirección General de Armamento y Material (DGAM), Ministerio de Defensa
issuers.notes: Initial audit by the DGAM; renewal and surveillance audits by certification bodies recognised by the CMDIN. The DGAM issues a quote for the fee; no amount is published.

steps.priceNote: In your country the state issues this itself, so the vendor price ranges in our sources do not apply and none is shown.

prerequisites.name: RID registration (Registro de la Industria de Defensa, Spain)

consultants.title: PECAL quality requirements come with the contract
consultants.text: Prime qualification: if you supply through a prime contractor and not the Ministry directly, the prime qualifies its suppliers by its own procedure, which none of the sources read here publishes. Ask the prime, or a consultant, what it requires.

consultants.title: Establishment security clearance (HSES) for storing classified information
consultants.text: HSES path: what your site needs (secure storage, the company's control body, personnel clearances) is set case by case with the DGAM, or with the ONS for NATO, EU and ESA information, and the sources read here publish no cost or duration. A security consultant can tell you what it takes for your site.

asks.question: Will classified information be stored on your own premises?
Does the company hold an HSES (establishment security clearance)?
